adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the `url` is directly interpolated into an HTML anchor (`"#{url}"`) and appended to `contents`. The only validation is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which does not prevent quotes or other markup-breaking characters in the URL. This is then saved with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` for `:raw_html`, while the embed view renders it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. Together, this makes crafted URLs capable of injecting arbitrary HTML/JS into the rendered post body.
